def W(m,L,n): return torch.tensor(np.array(weights[f'{m}.layers.{L}.{n}']))
def ov(m,L,h):
    Wv=W(m,L,'self_attn.v_proj.weight'); Wo=W(m,L,'self_attn.o_proj.weight')[:,256*h:256*h+256]
    gin=1+W(m,L,'input_layernorm.weight'); gpost=1+W(m,L,'post_attention_layernorm.weight')
    return (gpost[:,None]*Wo)@ (Wv*gin[None,:])   # 640x640 maps input x -> output
def copyscore(M):
    S=(Es)@M.T@(Es*fn).T  # rows: source token, cols: output logits
    d=torch.diag(S)
    z=(d-S.mean(1))/S.std(1)
    rank=(S>d[:,None]).float().sum(1)
    return z.mean().item(), (rank<10).float().mean().item()

def intoks(v,k=15):
    s=Ein@torch.tensor(v)
    s=s/ E.norm(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-3)  # cosine-ish
    top=torch.topk(s,k).indices.tolist(); bot=torch.topk(-s,k).indices.tolist()
    return [vocab[i] for i in top],[vocab[i] for i in bot]
